messages:
Rae K: Quick check-in: proposing we group sidebar into three persistent zones to reduce depth: Projects / Registry / Admin. Goal is clearer deep links and simpler breadcrumbs. Figma: https://figma.com/s/side-ia-v2.

Jun P: From routing POV we should prefer path segments: /p/:projectId/zone/:zoneSlug/... for canonical links. Easier for analytics and feature flags.

Oli M: Agree. We'll normalize old ?zone= and #zone= on first load with history.replaceState -> canonical path, and emit nav.normalize telemetry.

Sana V: Accessibility nits: always set focus to main H1 on deep-link load, add aria-current="page" to active nav item, and ensure keyboard users can open/close groups with Enter/Space. Use a visible focus ring on zone headers.

a11y-bot: Reminder: add role="navigation" aria-label="Primary navigation" and skip link to #main-content. For collapsed crumbs provide an accessible menu for the hidden items.

Sam QA: Tests: deep-link load focus, back/forward after normalization, legacy-link normalization telemetry, and crumb collapse keyboard operability. Watch scroll-jump on anchor loads.

Rae K: Microcopy: left nav "Model Registry" full, compact label "Registry". Breadcrumb root = "Projects" not "Workspace". Compact breadcrumbs show Projects / … / Registry / Versions.

Jun P: Implementation plan: router change to /zone/:zoneSlug/*, parser for legacy query/hash, soft normalization, sessionStorage for collapse state (not canonical). I'll draft the PR.

Oli M: Note: if we replaceState too aggressively users lose back history. Use replaceState for silent normalizations and pushState if we detect repeated legacy traffic. We'll instrument before rollout.

Sana V: Also ensure sr-only text announces ", current" when an item becomes active and that live region announces zone changes politely.

Rae K: Action items: Rae update Figma + copy; Jun PR for router + normalization; Sana add a11y checklist; Sam QA add e2e tests. Will reconvene after mock updates. :sparkles:
